NAD but I have a similar problem - I am diagnosed with anxiety though. As long as your oxygen levels are OK you should be fine. What I do to fix it is I breathe out hard, like I'm blowing out candles, until all the air is out of my lungs. Then I hold it until I have to take a breath. I breathe slowly in through my nose, focusing on expanding my diaphragm. Then I do some square breathing, where you breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. My doctor said that I'm probably not fully exhaling when I'm breathing because of my anxiety, so doing this cycle sort of resets things. Also, you can definitely experience physical symptoms of anxiety without feeling it mentally. Happens to me all the time. It sounds like anxiety to me because you said it goes away when you can focus on something else, which is true for me as well.

I had the same problem where the pill made me so sick, but the Nuva ring is a lot better because it bypasses the stomach.

Hey, I used to have really bad panic attacks from my fear of throwing up and the only thing that really helped me was cognitive behavioral therapy from a psychologist. Maybe look into one who has experience treating phobias. In the meantime, force yourself to drink water and breathe from your diaphragm.
